title: Toys: CE marking, test evidence and Declaration of Conformity
summary: A toy placed on the EU market requires a conformity assessment against the essential safety requirements, an EU Declaration of Conformity, and CE marking. Flagged in v1; the category depth is v2.

required_evidence.label: Test report against the EN 71 series

sources.title: Directive 2009/48/EC on the safety of toys
sources.note: Fetched the consolidated text directly. Both citations confirmed exactly as drafted: Art. 4(2) requires manufacturers to draw up the EC declaration of conformity and affix CE marking once the applicable conformity assessment (Art. 19) demonstrates compliance with Art. 10/Annex II; Art. 15 sets the declaration's own content requirements. effective_from (2011-07-20) matches the Directive's own transposition/application date. No changes needed.
